outcome: Ready for fresh research captures; does not meet product advancement gates.
methodology: V3: 21 saved-scene repetitions plus three diagnostics. After one restriction omission, one generalized revision V4: six real-scene repetitions, five single-run target controls and three single-run diagnostics. Same previously inspected images. This is prompt calibration, not held-out acceptance.
promptDesign: Separate operation/user facts from untrusted visible source data
Bind the composer before relevance selection
Explicit language request wins; guidance language alone does not translate
Require restrictions in final draft as well as evidence
Preserve chronology, reported-vs-verified distinctions, stance and commitment strength
Abstain only for required missing source facts or ambiguous targets
Keep schema, capture and auth boundaries unchanged
remainingFailures: Two Slack drafts still describe an earlier external-publication configuration blocker as current despite a later 追加しました response. Chronology failure.
One LinkedIn output has awkward ぜひ興味があり phrasing.
Some evidence excerpts have minor transcription changes or broad partial/geometry claims; they are not original AX text.

economics.basis: Mean input and total completion usage of six real-scene repetitions; standard uncached equivalent, not invoice
economics.latencyCaveat: Saved capture replay excludes native capture; wall includes app launch/auth/network; six observations cannot establish a stable percentile.
